action_items: Nothing blocking. The Watch page emits 2 initial fetches because of React.StrictMode in dev — harmless in production but worth noting if you ever observe doubled telemetry. No fix required.

Consider adding a DELETE /api/admin/github/set-remote (or accept empty url) so admins can unset a wrong remote without shell access. Currently the only way to clean up is `git remote remove origin` from the host.

After test_set_remote_valid, /app retains a remote pointing at https://github.com/example/streamhub.git in DB settings as well as the on-disk git config. The test agent cleaned the git remote via `git remote remove origin`, but settings.github_repo still stores the URL. Backend tolerates this (GET /check falls back to git config which is now empty), but it is worth wiping settings.github_repo too for cleanliness.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:1352 admin_github_set_remote — URL validation is prefix-only; 'https://' followed by garbage still passes. Could optionally `git ls-remote` to validate connectivity. Low priority.

/app/backend/server.py:776 subtitles reorder — request validation correctly ensures shape, but the response sends back the full video doc which can be large; for a reorder action a smaller {subtitles:[...]} ack would suffice. Cosmetic.

/app/backend/server.py:1733 video_status_ws — `await websocket.receive_text()` loop keeps the connection alive but never acts on incoming text; that's fine for a one-way push channel. Consider sending ping frames or relying on the WS protocol's built-in ping/pong to detect dead clients.

Frontend Watch page: please confirm that the WebSocket subscription is closed on unmount (cleanup function in useEffect). The two initial fetches in dev StrictMode suggest the effect runs twice — verify no zombie WS connections accumulate after navigating away/back.
/app/backend/server.py is now 1855 lines — long-overdue refactor into routers/ (mentioned in iter4, still applies).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter5_* chat message via guest send (auto-pruned by chat rolling-500 cap). Git remote was set to https://github.com/example/streamhub.git during testing and removed via `git remote remove origin` at the end. AppSettings.github_repo may still contain that URL in Mongo — non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py is green (10/10). Re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py -v`. For frontend WS testing, /api/videos/{id}/status WS sends one snapshot then idles — consume the first packet and close. rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all features behaving as designed. Initial test failure on chat-broadcast was due to wrong payload field names in MY test (`guest_session_id` vs `guest_session`, `chat.message` vs `message`); fixed in test, no backend bug.
